text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove gave it her absolute best and 
ran the "Osaka Hai" to the very end.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Looking back, she felt this race was a 
stepping stone toward her upcoming clash 
with Silence Suzuka, who would be waiting 
at the Takarazuka Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove was fired up to beat Silence 
Suzuka no matter what... Yet, deep down, 
there was a trace of unease on her face.
